public_api.name: NfrtChildIdentitySupplement::from_prepared
public_api.behavior: Refuse refresh first; hash-check immutable supplement/proof, bind exact target/actual-MC/recipe/raw-lock identity and all three original parent coordinate/content pins. Retains the original prepared input handle; does not rewrite dependency rows.

public_api.name: coordinate / exact_url / source_requests
public_api.behavior: Only exact per-target source-route tools and publisher artifact URLs, no unknown requests, aliases, POM/repository fallback or sidecar-as-artifact request. Private requests bind supplement and original input identity.

public_api.name: function_requests
public_api.behavior: Caller must present the exact frozen function classpath. Preserves original order, including Vineflower followed by the plugins JAR on 26.1.2; mismatches fail before caller effects.

public_api.name: verify_child_bytes
public_api.behavior: No cache opening or repair. Checks private request equality/context, bounded exact length and full approved SHA-256 of caller-supplied bytes.

public_api.name: verify_parent_bytes
public_api.behavior: No file opening or acquisition. Checks selected original parent pin through PreparedDependencyInputs, full previously authenticated SHA-256/length, exactly one bounded config.json/tools.properties entry and its full SHA-256. Returns evidence only, not subprocess permission.

public_api.name: receipt
public_api.behavior: Separately binds original request catalog, source lock, child supplement, official proof, inventory and parent-proof identities. Records compiler release independently of minimum tool JVM. Explicit native_execution_enabled=false; parent bytes still required at consumption.
